name: Deusaderm Panda Eye Treatment
summary: Deusaderm collagen under the eyes, considered for dark circles caused mainly by hollowing and thin skin, not pigment or blood vessels.
leadAnswer: Deusaderm panda eye treatment injects small amounts of cross-linked, pig-derived collagen under the eyes. It aims to soften a hollow that casts a shadow, often where the skin is thin. It does not treat brown pigment or visible blood vessels, so a doctor first checks what is causing your dark circles.
seoTitle: Panda Eye Treatment Malaysia: Deusaderm Collagen | Kaiteki
seoDescription: Deusaderm panda eye treatment in Malaysia: collagen for dark circles caused by under-eye hollows. How doctors assess them, the risks and who should avoid it.

facts.label: Dark circles it is considered for

variantModule.heading: Deusaderm or hyaluronic acid filler under the eyes?
variantModule.intro: Both can be considered for an under-eye hollow. Neither is better for everyone.

items.title: Deusaderm
items.body: A white gel with no hyaluronic acid, which holds water. Doctors consider it where puffiness, an overfilled look or the bluish tint of a clear gel is a concern. It cannot be dissolved.

items.title: Hyaluronic acid filler
items.body: A clear gel that can be dissolved with hyaluronidase if needed, which matters in this area.

ctaMid.heading: Not sure Deusaderm suits your dark circles?
ctaMid.body: A doctor can check what is causing yours and which treatment fits, if any.

avoidIf.lead: Infection, inflammation or a skin condition
An allergy to collagen, pork-derived products or lidocaine,
avoidIf.body: or a past reaction to a collagen filler.

avoidIf.lead: Autoimmune disease, keloid scarring or a bleeding disorder,
avoidIf.body: or taking blood thinners, immunosuppressants or steroids.

avoidIf.lead: A permanent implant or earlier filler under the eyes
Dark circles that are mainly pigment or visible vessels,

bringToConsult: Come without eye makeup if you can. Bring a daylight photo, since overhead lights deepen under-eye shadows, and any record of past under-eye filler.

sessionSteps.title: Consultation and assessment
sessionSteps.body: Your first visit is a consultation. The doctor checks which kind of dark circles you have.

sessionSteps.title: History and consent
sessionSteps.body: Your medication, past treatments and the risks are discussed before you decide.

sessionSteps.title: Numbing
sessionSteps.body: A numbing cream may be applied, and the gel itself contains lidocaine.

sessionSteps.title: Small, careful placement
sessionSteps.body: Small amounts, with a fine needle or a blunt cannula. The injecting itself is brief.

sessionSteps.title: Review
sessionSteps.body: The collagen is absorbed over months, so a further session may follow rather than more product at once.

afterSession.intro: Most people return to normal activity the same day.

bands.title: The first days
bands.body: Swelling, tenderness and bruising are common, and show more under the eyes.

bands.title: The following week
bands.body: Bruising can last a week or more, so leave time before any important event.

afterSession.aftercare: Aftercare usually means cold compresses and not rubbing the area. Contact the clinic straight away about sudden pain, skin turning pale or any change in your vision.

risks.common: Bruising, swelling and tenderness, and redness, itching or flaking at the injection points.
risks.lessCommon: Small lumps (nodules), and allergic reaction or infection, as with any animal-derived implant. Rarely, serious vascular complications, which are gravest around the eye.
cannotDo: It does not lighten pigment or treat visible blood vessels.
It cannot be dissolved if a lump or uneven result appears.
It is not permanent: the collagen is absorbed over months.
risks.disclose: Your doctor explains the risks, and which symptoms to report, before anything is booked.

sections.heading: Which type of panda eyes is Deusaderm for?
body: Deusaderm is considered for panda eyes that are mainly a shadow from a hollow under the eye, often with thin, crepey skin over it. Collagen placed beneath it aims to soften that shadow.
Most dark circles have more than one cause, especially from the mid-thirties, so collagen is often one part of a plan. The usual routes are:
list: A hollow under the eye: Deusaderm or hyaluronic acid filler may be considered.
Thin, crepey skin over a hollow: Deusaderm or a skin booster may be discussed.
Brown pigment that stays when the skin is stretched: usually pigment laser and sun protection, not collagen.
A blue or purple tint from vessels: usually vascular laser or skin-quality treatment.
Puffiness, or swelling that comes and goes: checked first, as a medical question.
A shadow from the shape of the eye socket: no injectable changes bone, and concealer may do more.

sections.heading: What does the doctor check before injecting under the eyes?
body: The doctor looks at the area in different light and angles, and gently stretches the skin. Darkness that fades when light shines straight on it is likely a shadow from a hollow. A brown tone that stays is more likely pigment.
The doctor also asks whether the area tends to look puffy, and about any eyelid surgery or eye condition.

sections.heading: Why is under-eye collagen placed so cautiously?
body: Under-eye skin is the thinnest on the body. Anything placed beneath it can show as an outline, a lump or a change in colour.
So the doctor places small amounts, at a depth chosen for your anatomy, and may stage treatment with a review in between.
Collagen also cannot be dissolved, and rare vascular complications are most serious around the eye. So the doctor would rather place less and review.

sections.heading: What does research on under-eye collagen show?
body: The evidence is limited, and no study predicts how your own eyes will respond. Results vary between individuals.
list: A 2024 study injected Sunmax's FACIALGAIN collagen around the eyes of a small group. Changes in skin lightness readings had faded by 12 weeks.
That study had no control group, was funded by the maker, and named a different Sunmax product, not Deusaderm.
A separate 2024 trial of Sunmax's collagen saw no bluish tint (the Tyndall effect), but it treated smile lines, not the under-eye area.

faqs.q: Will Deusaderm clear my panda eyes completely?
faqs.a: It is unlikely. Collagen is aimed only at the hollow, and most dark circles have more than one cause. Any improvement is usually partial.

faqs.q: Can I have Deusaderm if I've had under-eye filler before?
faqs.a: Possibly, once the doctor has assessed what is already there. If hyaluronic acid filler there needs dissolving, that is done first, in a separate procedure.

faqs.q: What if I avoid pork-derived products?
faqs.a: Deusaderm is made from pig collagen, so tell your doctor. Non-animal options, such as hyaluronic acid filler, can be discussed instead.

faqs.q: Can Deusaderm help dark circles that run in the family?
faqs.a: It depends on what is inherited. A family tendency to hollowing may be assessed for Deusaderm. Inherited brown pigment is not something collagen lightens.
